owner_and_capability: Class Day View — class day report, supervision sheet and class-wide arrival exceptions in modules/classday; Enrollment — care usage and class roster reports, their export audit and the class roster of a day in modules/enrollment (#3563)
atomic_cutover: The class day report, the supervision sheet and the arrival exception seam move from services/enrollment into the Class Day View application; the care usage and class roster reports, their export audit and the class roster of a day move into the Enrollment application. Enrollment publishes the day roster as a Reports query that the root binds to the Class Day View port, so no new policy permission is added. People, groups, guardian contacts, status days, settings, the GDPR access log and the realtime announcement reach both applications through ports the root binds. The five retained files are deleted with no second provider; the decision flow keeps its own export audit writer until #3564.
tests: The class day, supervision sheet and arrival exception unit suites run in modules/classday/internal/application against fakes of the new ports.
The care usage, class roster and day roster unit suites run in modules/enrollment/internal/application against fakes of the new ports.
The class-day HTTP, school portal and enrollment export router suites exercise the composed capabilities against the test database.
scripts/backend-architecture.sh check and scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development without --fast verify the architecture ratchet and affected packages.
